solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Tool hits article moving left to right

indicators.note: the letter at the left-hand end of the assembled string is shifted across to the right-hand end

parts.note: to whack is to hit hard, so hits gives whacks
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A tool strikes a piece of writing as it travels across the page.
explanation.walkthrough: WHACKS plus A gives WHACKSA; the opening W then travels to the far end.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw with a fine blade in a frame, used for cutting metal, is a common workshop tool.

clue.text: Stop in popular state capital

indicators.note: the word for stop goes inside the word for popular

parts.note: something hot is in demand, popular
to bar is to stop or block

explanation.surface: A stopover in a well-liked state capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Tasmania, an Australian state.

clue.text: This cloth hat with stitching might become a Catholic

indicators.note: stitching the answer together with the word hat, then reworking it, makes the phrase a Catholic

explanation.surface: A fabric hat, sewn up, could make someone a Catholic.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: the answer's letters plus HAT rearrange to A CATHOLIC.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain cotton fabric, often printed, is a familiar cloth.

clue.text: Depicted horse carrying knight about poorly

indicators.note: the horse carries the other letters inside it

parts.note: a steed is a horse
N is the chess notation for knight
c, for circa, means about
ill means poorly

explanation.surface: Shown: a horse bearing a sick knight about.
explanation.definitionFit: A design traced through a cut-out template has been drawn, that is portrayed.

clue.text: Wine and punch consumed by partners

indicators.note: the punch is swallowed inside the partners' letters

parts.note: West and East are partners at the bridge table
to hit is to punch

explanation.surface: Wine and fruit punch are drunk by a couple.
explanation.walkthrough: W and E are partners in bridge, the card game.
explanation.definitionFit: Wine made from pale grapes, such as Chablis, is a colour category of wine.

clue.text: Judge when to dig up shrub

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
to mine is to dig minerals up from the ground

explanation.surface: A judge decides the right moment to uproot a bush.
explanation.definitionFit: A climbing plant with fragrant white or yellow flowers, often grown as a garden shrub.

clue.text: 14 stone dog

parts.note: jet is a black gemstone
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: A world traveller, a stone and a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the answer to 14 Across, a frequent traveller.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone flying around the world for pleasure is a wealthy international traveller.

clue.text: Interference from meddlers? No way!

indicators.note: the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Is interference coming from busybodies? Certainly not!
explanation.definitionFit: White speckle on an analogue television screen from poor reception is interference.

clue.text: Flood I see engrossing religious devotee

indicators.note: engrossing means taking in, so I and the word for see hold the devotee within

parts.note: to see someone is to date them
a nun is a woman devoted to religious life

explanation.surface: I witness a deluge absorbing a pious worshipper.
explanation.definitionFit: To flood is to overwhelm with water, or with too much of anything.

clue.text: Unceasingly cruel to oust leader, outflanking 1000 soldiers

indicators.note: the shortened word surrounds the others on both sides
the word drops its first letter

parts.note: severe can mean harsh, cruel
M is the Roman numeral for 1000
OR, other ranks, are ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: Relentlessly harsh, aiming to remove a commander while surrounding a thousand troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary word meaning always, for all time to come, without stopping.

clue.text: Dish that would be identified if lad consumes it

indicators.note: the lad swallows the answer, so taking the lad away from the word for identified leaves what was eaten

parts.note: labelled means identified, given a name tag
taken as written

explanation.surface: A meal that a boy could recognise only once he has eaten it.
explanation.walkthrough: Read backwards in logic: LAD consuming the answer makes LABELLED (identified), so LABELLED less L, A and D leaves it. Dish is slang for an attractive person, not food.
explanation.definitionFit: Dish is slang for an attractive person, and a belle is a beautiful woman.

clue.text: Propose reduction in circulation

indicators.note: things in circulation are moving around, so the letters of the word before are moved about

explanation.surface: Suggest cutting the amount of money in use.
explanation.definitionFit: To propose a motion or a bill is to bring it forward, which is to put it before a meeting.

clue.text: Glanced one Communist in bed guarded by another

indicators.note: the whole group of letters is surrounded, as if by guards, by the second Communist

parts.note: another Communist, that is a red
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the revolutionary's name sits inside the word for a bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Che Guevara, the Marxist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A Communist in bed, watched over by a comrade, briefly looked up.
explanation.walkthrough: Che Guevara is the Communist; 'another' means a second Communist, a red. 'Glanced' means bounced off, not looked briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: A bullet or ball that glanced off a surface bounced away at an angle.

clue.text: Average cut in half about the same

indicators.note: about signals that the kept letters are read backwards
only the first half of the word for average is kept

parts.note: mediocre means only average

explanation.surface: An average figure, halved, comes to roughly the same.
explanation.walkthrough: MEDIOCRE halved is MEDI, which 'about' turns to IDEM.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin word used in references to mean as previously mentioned, from the identical source.

clue.text: Native American area lawman recalled has not changed

indicators.note: recalled, called back, means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a cop is a policeman

indicators.note: changed means the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A local policeman has been brought back, apparently unaltered.
explanation.definitionFit: The Powhatan woman known from the Jamestown story is a famous Native American.

clue.text: One who frequently displays pass with foot behind ball

indicators.note: the word for foot comes behind, after, the word for ball

parts.note: a globe is a ball, a sphere
a trotter is a pig's foot

explanation.surface: A footballer who often shows off a pass, kicking with his heel behind the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pass' is a passport, not a football pass.
explanation.definitionFit: A world traveller is forever showing a passport at borders.

clue.text: Line dividing improves disheartened shoppers

indicators.note: the line splits the shortened word in two
the heart, one of the middle letters, is removed

parts.note: to better something is to improve it
a ray is a straight line from a point

explanation.surface: A queue cutting through improves the mood of glum customers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shoppers' is slang: to shop someone is to inform on them.
explanation.definitionFit: To shop someone is British slang for to inform on them, so shoppers are traitors.

clue.text: Last bit of route in grass turned so rocklike

indicators.note: that letter goes inside the turned word
turned means the word is read backwards

parts.note: to grass is to inform, to sing to the police

indicators.note: only the final letter of route is used

parts.note: sic is Latin for so, thus

explanation.surface: The end of a path is so overgrown, it has gone stony.
explanation.walkthrough: SING reversed is GNIS; E goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Describes the banded metamorphic rock gneiss, so resembling that stone.

clue.text: Craft on radar, north of country

indicators.note: craft as a verb means to make with skill, so the letters are fashioned anew

explanation.surface: An aircraft on radar, to the north of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Craft' looks like an aircraft but signals the anagram; 'north of' places N below in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Belonging to the small Pyrenean principality, so relating to that nation.

clue.text: Integrated new functioning car seat in buggy

parts.note: a machine that is functioning is on

indicators.note: buggy means full of faults, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A new working car seat has been fitted into a pushchair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'buggy' looks like a baby's pushchair, but it is the anagram signal, faulty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something open to all denominations rather than one sect is integrated in the sense of mixed.

clue.text: Queen draped in two forms of gold before a goddess

indicators.note: the gold section comes before the final letter
the queen is covered by the gold letters

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold and OR is gold in heraldry
R is short for Regina, queen

explanation.surface: A queen clothed in gold of two kinds precedes a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman deity of the dawn is a goddess.

clue.text: Relative holds up unfinished fruit drink

indicators.note: in a down clue the relative sits beneath and supports the fruit
the final letter is left off

parts.note: a grape is a fruit
pa is father, a relative

explanation.surface: A relative raises a half-made fruit drink.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian brandy distilled from grape residue is a strong alcoholic spirit.

clue.text: Brought to the West, Oriental food club

indicators.note: in an across clue, the West is the left, so the word is read from right to left

parts.note: nori is the Japanese seaweed used in sushi

explanation.surface: An Eastern food has been imported to Western restaurants.
explanation.definitionFit: A golf club with an angled metal head is called by this name.

clue.text: One recording a feller in conversation on boat

indicators.note: in an across clue, X on Y puts X after Y

parts.note: a cat is short for catamaran, a twin-hulled boat

indicators.note: spoken in conversation, so we want what the words sound like

parts.note: a logger is one who fells trees

explanation.surface: A lumberjack chats away while on a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who records items in a list or index compiles entries one by one.

clue.text: Magician's assistant that is involved in a game

indicators.note: the abbreviation is placed inside the other letters

parts.note: RL is rugby league
ie is short for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A conjuror's helper takes part in a contest.
explanation.walkthrough: The magician is Prospero in Shakespeare's The Tempest, served by this spirit.
explanation.definitionFit: The airy spirit serving Prospero in The Tempest acts as the magician's helper.

clue.text: Former head, not second-rate

indicators.note: not means the letter is removed

parts.note: bonce is British slang for the head
B is a second grade, second-rate

explanation.surface: An ex-boss who was certainly not mediocre.
explanation.definitionFit: Once as an adjective means former, as in the once king.

clue.text: Not totally peaceful, capture island region of Africa

indicators.note: the word is not given in full, losing its final letter

parts.note: serene means calm, peaceful
to get is to catch or capture

explanation.surface: A not entirely tranquil scene of seizing an island off Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: The great Tanzanian plain famous for its wildlife migrations is an African region.

clue.text: March is not good time, looking back

indicators.note: looking back means the letters are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: poor means not good

explanation.surface: March proves a bad month when one reflects on it.
explanation.definitionFit: To troop is to walk together in a group, as soldiers do when they march.

clue.text: Cold guards, beginning to shake, burnt material

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: the guards shake off their beginning, losing the first letter

parts.note: minders are bodyguards

explanation.surface: Freezing sentries start to tremble near the ashes of a fire.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beginning to shake' reads as starting to tremble but means losing the opening letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Small pieces of partly burnt coal or wood left after a fire are residue of combustion.

clue.text: Land of the lush borders set originally around theatre

indicators.note: the land surrounds, forms the borders of, the other letters

parts.note: la-la land is a dreamy, intoxicated state of mind, where a drunk might be

indicators.note: only the opening letter of the word set is used

parts.note: ca, short for circa, means around

explanation.surface: A drunkard's country edges the original set around a playhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: LALA (la-la land) surrounds S and CA.
explanation.definitionFit: Milan's famous opera house is one of the world's best-known theatres.
